unit_note: USD millions. Page 24, Table 6 Schedule A. Dots mark no transactions and are omitted. The Revisions by Federal Agencies line prints dots in both current columns. 10 sums (8 exact, 2 within 1; rounding note on p24): the prior-year current-basis opening, Total Surplus (-) or Deficit = On-Budget + Off-Budget, Total Transactions Not Applied, and the close of period in all three columns. The two that are off by 1 are the This Month and Fiscal Year to Date closes. The current-basis opening and the close (29,489,259 / 29,885,145) equal Table 6's Excess of Liabilities line on p23. The total deficit equals that table's financing line, and the total of transactions not applied is the negative of its line.
